title: CCELL Silo 510 Battery
description:
The Silo is an evolution of CCELL’s quality and compact 510 batteries that combine performance and function in one sleek design. The Silo comes with all symbolic CCELL features, such as a button-free profile, a discreet breathing indicator, a micro-USB charging port, inhale-activated, and an aluminum alloy housing which offers a sophisticated aesthetic. The magnetic connector is compatible with 510-thread cartridges, and creates an easy-to-use drop in system. With a battery capacity of 500mAh, this vaporizer can generate over 250 puffs per charge cycle, and provides 25% more vapor volume when compared to other brands. It is recommended to use the Palm with CCELL cartridges to achieve maximum flavour, performance, and potency.

Battery Features:
Dimensions: 63 x 18 x 28.8 mm
Capacity: 500mAh
Micro-USB Port
Inhale-Activated
Aluminum Alloy Housing
Stealthy Breathing LED Indicator
Magnetic Connect with Built-In 510 Thread

What’s in The Box:
1x – CCell Silo Auto Draw Cartridge Vaporizer
2x – Magnetic Adapters
1x – Micro USB Charging Cable
